chart_rows.description: Learns a train-only pixel foreground model from multiscale intensity, contrast, Laplacian, and gradient features while treating positive IDs only as local instance annotations and excluding unknown/invalid pixels. Sampling balances object pixels with random and bright hard negatives. Threshold and touching-object splitting parameters are selected by object-level IoU-0.5 F1 on deterministic held-out contiguous patch groups, reducing likely source-field leakage. Final instances are connected foreground regions split by distance-transform peaks; objects under four pixels are removed, IDs are local to each test image, and padded pixels are forced to zero.

Trains a pixel foreground classifier from intensity features, ignoring unknown training pixels and treating instance IDs as local to each patch. Uses held-out training patches only to select a foreground threshold and peak spacing; this patch validation is calibration, not an independent-field score. Converts foreground regions into instances with intensity-guided watershed and zeros predictions outside each test image’s extent.
